$comment: The fixture corpus. Every later epic is measured against this, which is why it lands in E1
rather than E7 — there is nothing to measure before it exists.
'purityClass' maps to the six fixture classes ARCHITECTURE.md §2 requires of the purity harness.
'cause' maps to the nine reasons theming fails in ARCHITECTURE.md §1.
'epics' lists the epics that assert against this fixture.
Coverage is asserted by tests/unit/fixtures/corpus.tests.ts — if a §1 cause or §2 class ends up
with no fixture, that test fails rather than the gap going unnoticed.

fixtures.note: Strictest purity baseline — no script, so any mutation is unambiguous.
Page-authored style attributes rewritten 8 times, settling ~1.2s. The ADR 0001 items 1-4 case.
Holds a live reference to document.adoptedStyleSheets; detects array reassignment (ADR 0001 item 14).
Includes a shadow root nested inside another.
Unreachable by design. Must be reported honestly, not silently skipped.
No DOM text. Only compositing can help — the picker + scoped filter case.
Serializes its own innerHTML via MutationObserver — the Google Docs failure shape.
Stylesheet from the second origin; cssRules throws SecurityError.
Constructed stylesheets should carry us here; DNR relaxation stays opt-in.
Hash class names (css-1a2b3c, sc-bdVaJa, _1x2y3z) plus a late insertRule.
Tier 0 target: force the media query, touch nothing else.
Must stand down rather than double-invert.
Throughput CHURN case. Only ~141 inline-styled elements exist at once, but a 60-frame scroll creates ~8,400 of them (~17k/sec). Rate pressure, not count.

Throughput COUNT case, and the fixture that decides the E2 design. 2,000 simultaneous inline-styled elements, static. Sits at the measured crossover where per-element selector emission stops fitting the ARCHITECTURE.md §9 budget: Blink buckets rules by rightmost compound, so purity-legal selectors all collide and matching goes O(M^2) at ~22ns per element x rule.
~1/3 of viewport left light — must be flagged.
False-positive guard for the <10% acceptance criterion. Must NOT be flagged.
transparent must resolve up the ancestor chain, not read as black.
The exclude-treatment case. Inverting this makes it wrong, not dark.
img, canvas, svg, and background-image all need the counter-filter. Assets are data URIs — no network.
id and semantic-attribute strategies should win with high confidence.
Every id matches the reject pattern and must not anchor a selector.
nth-child path must anchor at #app, not at body.
Buttons force zero-match and over-match; both must degrade to no-op plus notice.
UA-styled controls behave differently from authored CSS.
Upstream writes data-darkreader-inline-invert on page SVG roots (ADR 0001 item 6).
Overlays are where painted-area sampling most often miscounts.
Stylesheet at 800ms, inline-styled element at 1600ms.

229 catalog sites use ignoreInlineStyle. Under declaration keying it cannot be an early return: each pair here carries a byte-identical style attribute, one inside an ignored region and one outside, so a dropped exclusion makes them indistinguishable to the emitter and themes both.
Resolution through custom properties, including a locally overridden scope.

knownGaps: Cause 9 (restricted pages: chrome://, the Web Store) cannot be a fixture — the extension is not permitted to run there. It is verified by E7's restricted-page detection test instead, not by this corpus.

No fixture yet reproduces a real Google Sheets or Figma document. canvas-rendered.html and webgl-canvas.html approximate the rendering model; the E2 Sheets round-trip test needs the real application and is tracked on its own issue.
